User Roles & Permissions

The Eisenhower system uses roles to control what actions each user can perform. Your system administrator assigns you a role when creating your account.

Role Overview

Role

Description

Admin | Full system access Manager | Can create and manage portfolios, projects, and tasks Member | Can create and edit tasks within assigned portfolios Viewer | Read-only access to data for which they have clearance

Admin

Full system access. Can manage all users, configure security, and perform administrative tasks.

Permissions:

  • Manage all users and their roles

  • Configure system-wide security settings

  • Access all data regardless of clearance

  • Perform database maintenance and backups

  • View and manage audit trails

Manager

Can create and manage portfolios, projects, and tasks. Can assign team members and manage resources.

Permissions:

  • Create and edit portfolios and projects

  • Assign tasks to team members

  • Manage resource allocations

  • View reports and generate briefings

  • Approve baseline changes

Member

Can create and edit tasks within assigned portfolios. Can update progress and report blockers.

Permissions:

  • Create and edit tasks in assigned portfolios

  • Update task progress and status

  • Report blockers and impediments

  • View assigned resources and schedules

  • Submit resource requisitions

Viewer

Read-only access to data for which they have clearance. Cannot modify any data.

Permissions:

  • View portfolios, projects, and tasks (read-only)

  • View schedules and reports

  • Access documents within clearance level
